news.title: Feijoo says Spain should withdraw as host if World Cup final goes to Morocco
news.lede: BARCELONA: Spanish opposition leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo says he would be willing to withdraw Spain as a host of the 2030 World Cup should FIFA award the final to Morocco, amid a fierce battle between the two countries to accommodate football’s biggest match. FIFA are yet to declare a venue for the final of the 2030 World Cup, hosted by Morocco, Portugal and Spain. Feijoo, who leads the conservative Popular Party, said on Thursday that it was “inarguable” that Spain should host the event. “Spain must host the World Cup final.

news.title: FIFA's legal head Garcia leaves as Infantino faces intense presidential re-election campaign
news.lede: GENEVA — FIFA’s top lawyer left the soccer body on Friday after eight years working for its president Gianni Infantino and a men’s World Cup in North America which drew intense scrutiny on disciplinary rulings. “Emilio García Silvero has expressed his wish to embark on a new chapter in his career and return to Spain after 15 years of working abroad in the service of international football,” FIFA said in a statement. As head of FIFA’s legal and compliance unit, García oversaw tournament disciplinary cases, transfer market rules and contractual disputes worldwide, and steered moving the soccer body’s lawyers from Zurich to Miami in 2023. García also introduced greater transparency in FIFA legal work with more case documents and rulings published, including lists of which clubs are sanctioned from the global transfer market.
